candidates.change_summary: Delete the initialized guard so MinSum can be overwritten even after initialization.
Replace the assignment with MinSum = _val + 1 so the stored value differs from the input.
Move the assignment before the initialized check so MinSum is updated even when the function reverts.
Replace the assignment `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the stored minimum sum is off by one from the argument.
Delete the assignment `MinSum = _val;` so MinSum is never updated and stays at its previous value (0).
Replace `locked_ = false;` at the end of the modifier with `locked_ = true;` so the lock is never released and a second SetMinSum call reverts, leaving MinSum at its first value.
Move `locked_ = true;` before `require(!locked_);` so every call to the modifier reverts, meaning SetMinSum never executes and MinSum is never set.
Delete the assignment 'Log = LogFile(_log);' so the Log reference is never set and SetLogFile() always returns the zero address.
Replace 'Log = LogFile(_log);' with 'Log = LogFile(address(0));' so SetLogFile() always returns the zero address regardless of the argument.
Replace 'Log = LogFile(_log);' with 'Log = LogFile(msg.sender);' so the stored Log address is the caller's address rather than the supplied argument.
Delete 'locked_ = false;' in the modifier so the lock never resets, causing any subsequent SetLogFile call to revert and leaving Log at its previous value.
